description: Tick-level analysis of a single promoted sweep run using wide event traces from data.sweep_wide_events. Select a session, then a run. Runs only appear here after being promoted via the Batch Promote workflow.

options.content:
### Sweep Wide Events — Session `${session_id}`  ·  Run `${run_id}`  ·  Symbol `${symbol}`
Only runs promoted via **Batch Promote to ClickHouse** appear in the Run dropdown. Use the **Sweep Leaderboard** to find a run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Events" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'

SELECT toFloat64(running_account_balance) AS "Final Balance" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Peak Capital Deployed
panels.description: Maximum total capital committed to open positions at any point during the run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(max(total_capital_deployed)) AS "Peak Capital Deployed" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'

panels.title: Peak Drawdown
panels.description: Worst unrealised drawdown recorded during the run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ABS(min(toFloat64(current_drawdown_pct))) AS "Peak Drawdown" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND current_drawdown_pct != 0

panels.title: Net Trading Profit
panels.description: Total equity (cash + open position mark-to-market) minus total invested (initial capital + monthly injections). Matches engine ROI numerator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (toFloat64(finalBal) + toFloat64(finalDeployed) + toFloat64(finalUPnL)) - toFloat64(initBal) - toFloat64(intDiv(maxCandles, 43200)) * ${monthly_injection:raw} AS "Net Trading Profit" FROM (SELECT argMin(running_account_balance, global_candle_count) AS initBal, argMax(running_account_balance, global_candle_count) AS finalBal, argMax(total_capital_deployed, global_candle_count) AS finalDeployed, argMax(unrealized_pnl, global_candle_count) AS finalUPnL, max(global_candle_count) AS maxCandles FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}')

panels.title: Net Trading Profit %
panels.description: ROI = (totalEquity - totalInvested) / totalInvested × 100. Matches engine ROI formula exactly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((toFloat64(finalBal) + toFloat64(finalDeployed) + toFloat64(finalUPnL)) - totalInvested) / totalInvested * 100 AS "Net Trading Profit %" FROM (SELECT argMin(running_account_balance, global_candle_count) AS initBal, argMax(running_account_balance, global_candle_count) AS finalBal, argMax(total_capital_deployed, global_candle_count) AS finalDeployed, argMax(unrealized_pnl, global_candle_count) AS finalUPnL, max(global_candle_count) AS maxCandles, toFloat64(argMin(running_account_balance, global_candle_count)) + toFloat64(intDiv(max(global_candle_count), 43200)) * ${monthly_injection:raw} AS totalInvested FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}')

panels.title: Total Capital Injected
panels.description: floor(total_candles / 43200) × monthly_addition from config. This is what is subtracted from balance growth to arrive at Net Trading Profit. If 0, no monthly injections were configured.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(intDiv(max(global_candle_count), 43200)) * ${monthly_injection:raw} AS "Total Injected" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'

panels.title: Total Lost in Stop Losses
panels.description: Sum of (capital_deployed - exit_proceeds + exit_fee) across all stop_loss_executed events. Zero = no SLs triggered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(toFloat64(total_capital_deployed) - toFloat64(action_price) * toFloat64(action_quantity) + toFloat64(action_fee)) AS "Total Lost in SLs" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND event_type = 'stop_loss_executed'

panels.title: Win Rate
panels.description: Take-profit closes as a percentage of all position closes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(event_type = 'position_closed' AND close_reason = 'take_profit') / nullIf(countIf(event_type = 'position_closed'), 0) * 100 AS "Win Rate" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'

SELECT countIf(event_type = 'position_closed' AND close_reason = 'take_profit') AS "Take Profits" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'
SELECT countIf(event_type = 'stop_loss_executed') AS "Stop Losses" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'

panels.title: Total Realized PnL
panels.description: Sum of realized_pnl across all position_closed events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(sumIf(realized_pnl, event_type = 'position_closed')) AS "Total Realized PnL" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}'

panels.title: Account Balance Over Time
panels.description: Running account balance sampled at 15-minute intervals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFifteenMinutes(timestamp) AS timestamp, avg(toFloat64(running_account_balance)) AS "Account Balance" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Price & Capital Deployed
panels.description: Market close price (candle) vs total capital deployed into the position.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFifteenMinutes(timestamp) AS timestamp, avg(toFloat64(candle_close)) AS "Close Price", avg(toFloat64(total_capital_deployed)) AS "Capital Deployed" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Unrealized PnL & Drawdown %
panels.description: Unrealised P&L and drawdown percentage over the run timeline.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFifteenMinutes(timestamp) AS timestamp, avg(toFloat64(unrealized_pnl)) AS "Unrealized PnL", avg(toFloat64(current_drawdown_pct)) AS "Drawdown %" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Filled Orders Count (Safety Order Depth)
panels.description: Number of safety orders filled at any point in time. Higher = deeper in the DCA ladder.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFifteenMinutes(timestamp) AS timestamp, max(toFloat64(filled_orders_count)) AS "Max Filled Orders" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Individual Positions (Opens & Closes)
panels.description: Each completed position cycle: entry, close, action price/quantity/fee and max drawdown at close.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS "Time", event_type AS "Event", trade_id AS "Trade ID", toFloat64(action_price) AS "Action Price", toFloat64(action_quantity) AS "Quantity", toFloat64(action_fee) AS "Fee", close_reason AS "Close Reason", toFloat64(realized_pnl) AS "Realized PnL", toFloat64(current_drawdown_pct) AS "Drawdown %", toUInt32(filled_orders_count) AS "SO Depth", toFloat64(running_account_balance) AS "Balance After" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND event_type IN ('position_opened', 'position_closed', 'stop_loss_executed') ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Stop Loss Events
panels.description: Empty when no stop losses were triggered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS "Triggered At", trade_id AS "Trade ID", toFloat64(action_price) AS "Stop Loss Price", toFloat64(total_capital_deployed) AS "Capital Deployed", toFloat64(fees_accumulated) AS "Fees Lost", toUInt32(filled_orders_count) AS "SO Depth At Stop Loss" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND event_type = 'stop_loss_executed' ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Safety Order Level Usage
panels.description: How many times each safety order level was filled across all trades in this run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(order_number) AS "SO Level", count() AS "Times Filled" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND event_type = 'order_filled' AND order_number > 0 GROUP BY order_number ORDER BY order_number

panels.title: Event Type Breakdown
panels.description: Distribution of event types (price_changed excluded — it represents ~99% of all rows). position_opened = entries. order_filled = SO buys + TP sell orders. position_closed = TP exits. stop_loss_executed = stop loss hits.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_type AS "Event Type", count() AS "Count" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND event_type != 'price_changed' GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Trading Growth (ex-Injections)
panels.description: Account balance (blue) vs trading-only gain (green). The green line subtracts cumulative monthly capital injections: intDiv(candle_count, 43200) × monthly_addition. If monthly_addition = 0, both lines are the same.

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT toFloat64(running_account_balance) FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' ORDER BY global_candle_count ASC LIMIT 1) AS init_balance SELECT toStartOfFifteenMinutes(timestamp) AS timestamp, avg(toFloat64(running_account_balance)) AS "Account Balance", avg(toFloat64(running_account_balance)) + avg(toFloat64(total_capital_deployed)) + avg(toFloat64(unrealized_pnl)) - init_balance - toFloat64(intDiv(max(global_candle_count), 43200)) * ${monthly_injection:raw} AS "Trading Gain (ex-injections)" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Price & Trade Events Timeline
panels.description: 15-minute candle close price (grey line) with trade events overlaid as scatter points. Green = entry (position_opened). Orange = safety order fill (order_filled). Purple = take-profit close (position_closed). Red = stop loss (stop_loss_executed).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFifteenMinutes(timestamp) AS timestamp, avg(toFloat64(candle_close)) AS "Market Price" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp, if(event_type = 'position_opened', toFloat64(action_price), null) AS "Entry", if(event_type = 'order_filled', toFloat64(action_price), null) AS "Safety Order", if(event_type = 'position_closed', toFloat64(action_price), null) AS "Exit (TP)", if(event_type = 'stop_loss_executed', toFloat64(action_price), null) AS "Stop Loss" FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' AND symbol = '${symbol}' AND event_type != 'price_changed' ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Run Configuration
panels.description: Parameters used for this sweep run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT config_json->>'trading_pair' AS "Pair", LEFT(config_json->>'start_date',10) AS "Start", LEFT(config_json->>'end_date',10) AS "End", config_json->>'account_balance' AS "Balance", config_json->>'number_of_orders' AS "Orders", config_json->>'price_entry' AS "Entry", config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' AS "TP %", config_json->>'price_scale' AS "Price Scale", config_json->>'amount_scale' AS "Amt Scale", config_json->>'multiplier' AS "Leverage", COALESCE(config_json->>'stop_loss_enabled','false') AS "SL Enabled", config_json->>'stop_loss_percent' AS "SL %", config_json->>'stop_loss_baseline' AS "SL Baseline", config_json->>'stop_loss_timeout_minutes' AS "SL Timeout (min)" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE run_id::text = '${run_id}' LIMIT 1

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT toString(session_id) FROM data.sweep_wide_events ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 200
list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT toString(session_id) FROM data.sweep_wide_events ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 200

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT toString(run_id) FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 500
list.name: run_id
list.label: Run ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT toString(run_id) FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 500

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' ORDER BY symbol
list.name: symbol
list.label: Symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM data.sweep_wide_events WHERE toString(session_id) = '${session_id}' AND toString(run_id) = '${run_id}' ORDER BY symbol

list.definition: SELECT COALESCE((config_json->>'monthly_addition')::float, 0) FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND session_id = '${session_id}'::uuid LIMIT 1
list.name: monthly_injection
list.label: Monthly Injection
list.query: SELECT COALESCE((config_json->>'monthly_addition')::float, 0) FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND session_id = '${session_id}'::uuid LIMIT 1
